{{Short description|German physicist (born 1969)}}
'''Frank Scheffold''' ([[Pfullendorf]], Germany, 28 May 1969) is the head of the  Soft Matter and Photonics Group<ref name="University of Fribourg" /> in the physics department at the [[University of Fribourg]], Switzerland.<ref name="University of Fribourg_2">{{cite web | title=Frank Scheffold – Department of Physics | website=University of Fribourg | url=https://www.unifr.ch/phys/en/department/staff/prof/people/4427/12f46 | language=fr | access-date=18 January 2022}}</ref>

He studied at the [[University of Konstanz]] in Germany, as well as the [[Weizmann Institute of Science]] (Israel, with Prof. J. Klein). He obtained his doctorate summa cum laude at the [[University of Konstanz]], for research carried out with Prof. G. Maret at the [[Institut Charles Sadron|Institute Charles Sadron]] (Strasbourg, France) and Konstanz. His research in the Soft Matter and Photonics Group focuses on the optics of complex systems, dynamic light scattering and diffuse light propagation, the dynamics, aggregation and phase behaviour of colloidal systems and the production and characterization of soft materials.<ref name="University of Fribourg">{{cite web | title=Soft Matter & Photonics – Department of Physics | website=University of Fribourg | url=https://www.unifr.ch/phys/en/research/groups/scheffold/ | access-date=18 January 2022}}</ref> He is author and co-author of almost 100 articles.<ref name="University of Fribourg_2" /> He is currently a member of the Swiss National Research Council and the Steering Committee for "Polymers and Colloids" at the Swiss Chemical Society.
